text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of girls and boys who are not in pre-primary school
Share of girls and boys one year before official primary entry age (typically age 5) not enrolled in pre-primary
education, expressed as a percentage of the total population of girls and boys in that age group.
